room:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production game background sprite, a single top-down pixel-art room for a native 2D indie game.
Primary request: a cozy small bedroom/workroom containing a bed with sage-green blanket and pillow, a wooden table with a book and cup, a chair, a bookshelf, a potted plant, a chest, and a small woven rug. Leave generous connected empty floor where a player can walk.
Composition: landscape 3:2 aspect ratio, ideally 1536 by 1024. Whole room fills the image. Traditional straight-on top-down RPG interior, orthographic, axis-aligned rectangular room; no isometric diagonals and no perspective vanishing points. Walls only at the perimeter. Because this will be a playable collision map: bed in the upper-left quarter; bookshelf near the upper-right wall; table and chair on the right half; chest lower-left; plant near a corner. Leave the center and bottom-center free for walking. Show all furniture completely and separate silhouettes from floor.
Style: deliberate low-resolution pixel art, restrained cozy warm wooden floor and muted green/cream furnishing, crisp square pixels, clean chunky shapes with readable silhouettes at a 384x256 game size. A consistent coarse pixel grid, flat pixel color clusters, no smooth outlines, no blur, no painterly noise. Soft lighting represented by discrete pixel colors, not bloom.
Constraints: one room only, no character (character will be a separate sprite), no interface, no labels, no text, no watermark, no border outside the room, no exterior scene, opaque background. This is the actual room image to be rendered in the game, not a mockup screenshot.
player:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a production pixel-art player sprite on actual transparent PNG background for a top-down cozy indie game.
Primary request: one small friendly adventurer/resident, full body, dark tousled brown hair, simple sage-green jacket, tan trousers, dark brown boots. Facing down toward the player, viewed from the mildly overhead top-down RPG angle. Neutral standing pose, arms by sides, feet both visible.
Style: authentic clean low-resolution pixel art with a 24x32-pixel character silhouette, rendered as visibly square large pixel blocks with perfectly crisp edges and a very limited palette. Cute readable head/body proportions and simple dot eyes. No antialiasing, soft shading, painterly detail, smooth curves, or gradients.
Composition: exactly ONE character centered in a square canvas, entire body visible, occupies about 60% of canvas width and 85% of canvas height. Consistent pixel grid and transparent padding. Small enough visual complexity to read when displayed at 24x32 world pixels.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background with alpha, not white, not a painted checkerboard; no floor, no ground shadow, no labels, no border, no extra characters or frames, no weapons or elaborate props, no watermark. The room sprite is supplied separately.
animation:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D top-down RPG character walk-animation sprite sheet, genuine transparent PNG.
Use the attached character as the identity and pixel-art style reference: tousled brown hair, sage green open jacket, cream shirt, tan trousers, brown boots. Create a clean square sprite sheet containing exactly sixteen separate full-body frames in an exact four-column by four-row uniform grid. No borders, labels, text, shadows or background.
Row order from top to bottom: row 1 facing SOUTH toward viewer; row 2 facing WEST to viewer's left in side profile; row 3 facing EAST to viewer's right in side profile; row 4 facing NORTH away from viewer showing back of head/jacket.
Column order in EVERY row from left to right: 1 standing idle, 2 walking left leg forward with opposite arm forward, 3 standing passing pose matching idle, 4 walking right leg forward with opposite arm forward. Clearly different legs/arms in walking poses. Same character scale and stable head size in all cells; feet consistently at same cell baseline, no drifting across cells. One character per cell, exactly sixteen total. Crisp chunky hard-edged pixel art, no antialiasing, no painterly detail.
Each cell is an equal square one quarter of the canvas width and height. Center each character horizontally within its cell. Character top approximately 10% down into cell, boots baseline approximately 92% down. Character silhouette approximately 40% of cell width and 82% cell height. Leave generous fully transparent gutters inside every cell; no part crosses a cell boundary. Preserve the reference outfit and colors across every direction. Output a square 1024 by 1024 sheet if possible with each grid cell 256 by 256. All unused space genuinely transparent, no checkerboard drawn into image.
animation_transparency_edit: Edit this sprite sheet only to remove the entire gray and white checkerboard background, replacing ALL background pixels between and around the sixteen characters with genuine alpha=0 transparent PNG pixels. This must be actual transparency, not a visual representation of transparency. Preserve all sixteen character frames, exact poses, directions, positions, scale, colors, and the four-by-four layout unchanged. Preserve hard pixel-art silhouette edges, including open gaps between arms and body or legs. Do not draw any checkerboard, grid, labels, text, shadows, border, or replacement background. Output true RGBA with transparent background.
